overview.title: Project overview
overview.content: It is a conceptual project that aims to create a competitive local bubble tea shop brand and promote the brand through an engaging website interface. Key objectives revolve around crafting a distinct brand identity and implementing cutting-edge front-end web development.

intro.title: Goals
content: 1. Create and develop a competitve local bubble tea shop brand concept.
2. Establish an official website to promote and elevate the brand's presence.

intro.title: Tools
content: Figma,  Adobe Illustrator,  After Effect, VScode, Google Lighthouse

research.intro: The project commenced with comprehensive marketing research to gain deeper insights into the existing bubble tea shop market. This research is focused on understanding target audiences, identifying potential customers, analyzing industry trends, and evaluating the strengths and weaknesses of competitors.

approach.title: 🔎How is The Market? - Competitor Analysis
approach.content: Analyzing competitors' strengths and weaknesses is crucial for informing market development strategies. As the teashop operates locally, I curated a selection of comparable brands and meticulously examined their online presence, including website content and customer feedback across platforms like Yelp and Instagram. The findings were synthesized into a comprehensive analysis report.

approach.title: 📋How are my Customers? - Quality User Survey
approach.content: To better understand our target audience, I conducted a paper survey with 10 tea lovers. Each participant shared their habits and preferences through eight carefully crafted questions—giving us a window into real-world consumption behaviors and what drives their bubble tea choices.

approach.title: 👩Insights of Customer Experience
approach.content: Through analyzing competitors and conducting the paper survey, I've gained valuable insights into both the current market landscape and the preferences of our target users. By crafting personas, the aim is to vividly illustrate the pain points and needs of our target audience within the market trends.

achievements.title: Target audiences and popular promoting platforms
content: The target demographic interested in the tea drink market typically ranges from 20 to 35 years old, making them potential customers for our brand.
Leveraging various social media platforms such as marketing website, mobile app, or Instagram proves to be effective in branding promotion, enhancing brand and product visibility.

Creative branding design, top-notch product quality, and positive public reputation play pivotal roles in brand promotion. Cultivating a distinctive brand style elevates competitiveness within the market.

achievements.title: Product quality and customer service are significant in influencing consumption.
content: The target customer survey is designed to gather insights into consumption habits and preferences. Findings indicate that product quality and customer service strongly impact consumption decisions. The survey also shows customers'painpoints such as limited drink customization, indifferent service, and substandard beverage quality.

branding.intro: Guided by insights from the experience map, I kicked off the brand ideation phase. I started with a mind map built from standout keywords uncovered in UX research—sparking creative directions rooted in real user needs. From there, I shaped the brand’s core: defining its concept, crafting the name Unicup, and articulating a promise that reflects both innovation and personalization.

achievements.title: Brand name: Unicup
achievements.content: A blend of “unique” and “cup,” Unicup reflects our commitment to creative, high-quality tea experiences with a focus on aesthetics and outstanding service.

achievements.title: Brand concept
achievements.content: Rooted in creativity, energy, and quality, Unicup offers visually appealing, premium beverages in a vibrant and welcoming environment.

achievements.title: Brand promise
achievements.content: Unicup redefines bubble tea with customizable drinks through our signature Tea Lab experience. We promise innovation, top-tier ingredients, and exceptional customer service—delivering a one-of-a-kind tea journey every time.

UI.intro: I employed mood boards as a strategic tool to gather and structure a variety of UI ideas that align with the brand's positioning. Additionally, I established a comprehensive design guideline to provide a framework for consistent and cohesive UI design decisions moving forward.

achievements.title: Why these Colors and Typograhy
achievements.content:
To bring Unicup’s vibrant personality to life, I chose a light orange primary palette—fresh, energetic, and instantly inviting. Dark blue accents in icons and logos add a sense of creativity and trust, balancing playfulness with professionalism. These colors visually express the brand’s core values: uniqueness, customization, and premium quality.
For typography, I paired Baloo 2 and Poppins to create a clean, modern look with a friendly tone—making the digital experience both welcoming and easy to navigate.

achievements.title: How Logo and Icons Help Branding
achievements.content: The Unicup logo and icons feature smooth, rounded forms—capturing the creamy flow of milk tea and the bounce of tapioca pearls. Inspired by the universe, the logo weaves in cosmic elements to reflect the endless possibilities of tea customization. Subtle motion adds a floating, dreamy quality, turning a simple sip into an imaginative experience.

frontEnd.title: Building, Evaluating, and Improving
frontEnd.subtitle: SEO and Accessibility Evalutation with Light House
frontEnd.intro: To achieve the project’s objectives, I leveraged my front-end development skills to create an interactive web prototype. Built using HTML, SCSS, and React, the webpage is designed to be fast-loading, fully responsive, and highly interactive across various devices. Its performance, SEO, and accessibility were rigorously tested and optimized using Google Lighthouse, ensuring a seamless user experience.
achievements: Animations on logo, text, and images
Storing and using data with local JSON files

challenge.title: 1. Creating automatic srcolling across components
challenge.solution: Since it is a long one-page website, I need to create an automatic scroll for each menu item. By clicking each item, the event will call the function that activates corresponded component scroll into view. To get the target element while using the srcollIntoView method, I use the useState hook to declare each element as a variable and then forward the update state method as a reference in each child component. The forwarded reference will access the DOM node in the component and update the node to the state. Therefore, each click on the menu item will call its corresponded element into view.

challenge.title: 2. Corresponded menu item highlighting while scolling
challenge.solution: While scrolling down the page, the corresponded menu item should be highlighted automatically. Since this interaction is triggered by scrolling, I used the intersection observer constructor to observe each component. The boolean of intersecting will toggle the class style of the menu item. Therefore, if the intersecting is true for the component, its menu item will highlight with the icon.
